text: Jules requires access to your repositories to operate
quote: Jules needs access to your repositories in order to work.

text: Assign a coding task to Jules by applying a 'jules' label to a GitHub issue
quote: Use the "jules" label in an issue to assign a task directly in GitHub.

text: Jules runs tasks in a VM where it clones the repo, installs dependencies, and modifies files
quote: Jules runs in a virtual machine where it clones your code, installs dependencies, and modifies files.

text: Jules generates an implementation plan that you can review and approve before any code changes are made
quote: Once you submit a task, Jules will generate a plan. You can review and approve it before any code changes are made.

text: Jules automatically reads an AGENTS.md file in the repo root for context on conventions
quote: Jules now automatically looks for a file named AGENTS.md in the root of your repository.

text: You get notified when a task completes or needs your input
quote: You’ll be notified when the task completes or needs your input.

text: Jules produces a diff of proposed changes that you can browse and approve
quote: Jules provides a diff of the changes. Quickly browse and approve code edits.

text: Jules opens a pull request with its changes, which you can approve, merge, and publish
quote: Jules creates a PR of the changes. Approve the PR, merge it to your branch, and publish it on GitHub.

text: A public API lets you build custom workflows, automate bug fixing/code review, and embed Jules into tools like Slack, Linear, and GitHub
quote: You can use the API to create custom workflows, automate tasks like bug fixing and code reviews, and embed Jules's intelligence directly into the tools you use every day, such as Slack, Linear, and GitHub.

text: You can create an API key from the Settings page in the web app, up to 3 at a time
quote: In the Jules web app, go to the Settings page to create a new API key. You can have at most 3 API keys at a time.

text: An optional automationMode field controls whether a PR is automatically created after a task, defaulting to off
quote: The `automationMode` field is optional. By default, no PR will be automatically created.

text: You can send follow-up messages to an active agent session
quote: To send a message to the agent:

text: Higher-tier plans provide increased daily task and concurrency limits for power users and agent-heavy workflows
Priority access to newer underlying models, such as Gemini 3 Pro, is offered on certain plans
quote: Priority access to the latest models, starting with Gemini 3 Pro

text: The API supports a requirePlanApproval setting to force explicit plan approval before a session proceeds
quote: If you want to create a session that requires explicit plan approval, set the `requirePlanApproval` field to `true`.
